item.title: Is Andy Burnham more than just a smart-casual Sir Keir Starmer?
item.description: "Delve into the world of UK politics as we explore the leadership style and vision of Andy Burnham, often compared to Labour leader Sir Keir Starmer. Tune in to discover what sets him apart and if he's more than just a 'smart-casual' counterpart."
